subject.title: test: consolidate OpenClaw test state fixtures

question: Should `plugin-sdk/test-state` be accepted as a supported repository-local contract for bundled extension tests, or should extension tests use a different owner boundary?
rationale: The implementation deliberately adds a named Plugin SDK subpath and documents it, so maintainers need to choose whether this is the intended long-term first-party extension testing seam rather than allowing an accidental parallel contract.

options.title: Accept the repo-local seam
options.body: Confirm that first-party extension tests may import `plugin-sdk/test-state` while the subpath remains excluded from published runtime artifacts.

options.title: Keep the fixture core-local
options.body: Require a different extension-test boundary and remove the new SDK subpath before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the repo-local seam
recommendation.body: Confirm that first-party extension tests may import `plugin-sdk/test-state` while the subpath remains excluded from published runtime artifacts.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the author of the proposed seam and its boundary mappings; broader ownership evidence is unavailable in the supplied material.
